patches_modified.name: Brave AMOLED theme
patches_modified.description: Patch-time AMOLED dark theme (issue #21): rewrites Brave dark chrome surfaces to pure black (or a custom opaque hex). Optional text and accent colors (defaults keep Brave's #f0f2ff / #737ade). Forces Material You dynamic colors off in bytecode (the pref is non-persistent) and overrides system neutral night roles on Android 12+. Apply Dark theme in Brave to see it. Does not change web content force-dark, NTP theme collections, or add a runtime color picker. Default off.

patches_modified.name: Keep Titanium Extensions Child Processes Alive
patches_modified.description: Experimental version-unpinned structural/data-flow patch: starts one main-process foreground service with persistent low-priority notification and forces child STRONG binding plus IMPORTANT/STRONG priority updates. Tolerates routine signature, register, and helper-name changes; ambiguous targets fail closed. May increase RAM, battery, and process pressure; mitigates LMK kills only. To hide the notification, use Android Settings > Apps > Titanium > Notifications (the keep-alive service stays active either way).
patches_modified.previous_description: Experimental version-unpinned structural/data-flow patch: starts one main-process foreground service with persistent low-priority notification and forces STRONG binding plus IMPORTANT priority only for extension child processes (detected via --extension-process, matching upstream Titanium commit ff12f1c). Renderer and GPU children keep stock priority, so RAM and battery pressure stay closer to baseline. Tolerates routine signature, register, and helper-name changes; ambiguous targets fail closed. Mitigates LMK kills only. To hide the notification, use Android Settings > Apps > Titanium > Notifications (the keep-alive service stays active either way).

patches_modified.name: Stop requests to dead servers
patches_modified.description: Removes the 30 second wait on the loading screen and the daily offline message, and stops the game from contacting Tapjoy, OpenFeint and Glu's dead servers. If the OBB is missing, the game says why.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the 30 second wait on the loading screen and the daily offline message, and stops the game from contacting Tapjoy, OpenFeint and Glu's dead servers.

patches_modified.name: Swipe up diagnostic (temporary)
patches_modified.description: Diagnostic build only. After each upward swipe, types what the detector measured: u<rise>/<drift>s<samples>=<outcome><when>, with rise and drift in dp. 6 means it would count as a swipe up, 2 means too short, 3 means too diagonal; a trailing m or e says whether that was reached mid-swipe or only at release. It only reports: it does not undo anything and does not stop the key being typed. Needs Swipe Left to Delete enabled. Off by default, and this patch will be removed once it has answered its question.
patches_modified.previous_description: Diagnostic build only. Types a digit after every swipe that moved, saying what the up-flick detector made of it: 1 means it never saw the gesture, 2 means the travel was too short, 3 means the motion was too diagonal, and 6 means it would have fired. It does not undo anything and does not stop the key being typed — it only reports. Cannot be used alongside "Swipe up to undo autocorrect", which records the same gesture. Off by default, and this patch will be removed once it has answered its question.

patches_modified.name: Swipe up to undo autocorrect
patches_modified.description: Swipe up on the keyboard to undo the last autocorrection — or, with none pending, the last edit — without the swiped key being typed. Off by default until it has been confirmed on a device.
patches_modified.previous_description: Swipe up on the keyboard to put back the word an autocorrect replaced. Gboard has the same undo on backspace, behind a setting; this adds a gesture for it and works whether or not that setting is on. A swipe with nothing to undo does nothing. Cannot be used alongside "Swipe up diagnostic (temporary)", which attaches to the same instruction. Off by default until it has been confirmed on a device.

patches_modified.name: Block Brave Telemetry
patches_modified.description: Blocks P3A product analytics, Brave Stats usage pings, crash dump uploads, WDP, Chromium UMA metrics, and Variations seed fetching.

patches_modified.name: Brave In-Product & Commercial Notification Optimizer
patches_modified.description: Eliminates background wakeups and notifications from Chromium tips scheduler (Job ID 105), Brave Rewards onboarding promo, and retention marketing campaigns.

patches_modified.name: Brave Origin
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Brave Origin and enables local feature toggle controls.

patches_modified.name: Brave Startup Performance Optimization
patches_modified.description: Optimizes startup time and eliminates background CPU/disk overhead by disabling unused OEM carrier partner customizations.

patches_modified.name: Clean New Tab Page
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored wallpaper images, Brave News/Today feeds, marketing widgets, and promo cards from the New Tab Page.

patches_modified.name: Clean Share URL
patches_modified.description: Strips tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, igshid, si, msclkid) when sharing or copying links.

patches_modified.name: Disable Background Sync & Periodic Sync
patches_modified.description: Eliminates background wakeups, radio modem activity, and battery drain by forcing GooglePlayServicesChecker.shouldDisableBackgroundSync() -> true and neutralizing wakeup tasks.

patches_modified.name: Disable Battery Status API & OS Listener
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes the Battery Status API (navigator.getBattery) to prevent cross-site device fingerprinting and drops OS battery change broadcasts.

patches_modified.name: Locale PAK Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unselected language resource PAKs from assets/locales/.

patches_modified.name: Native Bloat Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unused native companion binaries (Impress Vision AI, WireGuard VPN, and Android XR) to significantly reduce APK size.

patches_modified.name: Sensor Privacy Guard
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes motion, ambient, and orientation sensor providers to prevent hardware fingerprinting and tracking via Generic Sensor APIs.

patches_modified.name: Skip First Run
patches_modified.description: Skips the welcome screen, search engine selection, and onboarding First Run Experience (FRE) on clean installs.

patches_modified.name: Suppress In-App Promos & Surveys
patches_modified.description: Suppresses intrusive in-app rating surveys, Play Store review prompts, and marketing promo popups (YouTube promo, ad-free callouts, and Brave Ads onboarding).

patches_added.name: Core Integrity
patches_added.description: Applies essential runtime stability and integrity fixes for modified APKs: signature check bypass, instant launcher opening, and flag resilience.

patches_added.name: Feature Flags
patches_added.description: Unlocks hidden Google feature flags and UI customization experiments: redesigned access points menu, key border shape selector, cursor trackpad mode, grammar checker & Smart Compose, proactive suggestions dismiss button, emoji size scale, and Bluetooth microphone.

patches_added.name: Zero Bottom Inset
patches_added.description: Eliminates or customizes the navigation bar bottom inset padding (bottom chin/blank space) under the keyboard in gesture navigation mode.

patches_removed.name: Allow Modified APK
patches_removed.description: Bypasses internal signature check to allow custom APK execution.

patches_removed.name: Enable Access Points Menu Redesign
patches_removed.description: Enables the redesigned access points menu bar and customization panel (Panel V2).

patches_removed.name: Enable Bluetooth Microphone
patches_removed.description: Unlocks the 'Use Bluetooth microphone' setting under Voice typing preferences.

patches_removed.name: Enable Cursor Trackpad
patches_removed.description: Enables 2D trackpad cursor navigation and cursor lock mode by holding the spacebar.

patches_removed.name: Enable Dismiss Suggestions Button
patches_removed.description: Adds a close button (X) to dismiss proactive suggestions on the suggestion bar.

patches_removed.name: Enable Emoji Scale Setting
patches_removed.description: Unlocks the emoji size scaling setting in Gboard preferences.

patches_removed.name: Enable Grammar Checker
patches_removed.description: Unlocks Grammar check and Smart Compose / inline suggestions settings under Text correction preferences.

patches_removed.name: Enable Key Shape Selection
patches_removed.description: Enables the key border shape selection UI (Default, Semi-rounded, Round) in theme customization.

patches_removed.name: Phenotype Flag Resilience
patches_removed.description: Neutralizes Phenotype flag registration conflicts to allow runtime flag overrides without crashes.

patches_modified.name: Add AMOLED Theme
patches_modified.description: Adds a selectable Pure Black AMOLED theme using Gboard's native color_black theme package, without replacing Dark, Light, System Auto, or Dynamic Color.

patches_modified.name: Block Telemetry
patches_modified.description: Disables background metrics dispatch, event logging, daily pings, Google Primes profiling, crash reporting, AppDoctor diagnostics, and Tenor share tracking.

patches_modified.name: Clipboard Enhancements
patches_modified.description: Extends unpinned clipboard history retention duration, raises the maximum number of displayed unpinned clips, and allows customizing keyboard grid columns.

patches_modified.name: Clone Gboard
patches_modified.description: Changes the package name by appending a dot and custom suffix (defaults to 'clone') to allow installing Gboard alongside the original application.

patches_modified.name: Disable Background Sync
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes AndroidX WorkManager schedulers, MDD (Mobile Data Download) periodic sync, and Superpacks eager asset synchronization (opt-in to preserve initial dictionary downloads).

patches_modified.name: Disable Remote Configuration
patches_modified.description: Disables periodic remote experiment flag synchronization and background updates.

patches_modified.name: Force Incognito Mode
patches_modified.description: Forces Gboard to always operate in incognito mode (disabling personalized learning and persistent input logging) while keeping clipboard functionality enabled.

patches_modified.name: Hardened Intent Security
patches_modified.description: Enables Gboard internal external intent protection against unauthorized intent hijacking.

patches_modified.name: Offline Only
patches_modified.description: Completely isolates Gboard from the network by revoking network permissions, neutralizing HTTP clients (Cronet, OkHttp, Superpacks), and spoofing offline status.

patches_modified.name: Resource Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips embedded third-party license text, onboarding tutorial Lottie animations, promotional GIFs, and APK root metadata/junk files.

patches_modified.name: Strip Permissions
patches_modified.description: Selectively revokes sensitive hardware, privacy, and system permissions from AndroidManifest.xml.

patches_modified.name: Top Toolbar Item Count
patches_modified.description: Customizes the maximum number of access point icons displayed on the top toolbar.

patches_modified.name: Ad Dispatch Governor
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes ad loaders, unlocks ad-free status, and strips mediation components & startup providers.

patches_modified.name: Asset Debloat
patches_modified.description: Strips embedded ad DEX, tracking scripts, web templates, and ad drawables to reduce APK size.

patches_modified.name: Background Sync Optimizer
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes background WorkManager constraint tasks and diagnostic wakelocks.

patches_modified.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes Firebase Analytics, Google Measurement, TikTok Business SDK, and crashlytics tracking.

patches_modified.name: Multi-Store Debridger
patches_modified.description: Disables orphan billing activities, services, and permissions for alternative OEM stores (Huawei, Xiaomi, Samsung).

patches_modified.name: Network Security Hardening
patches_modified.description: Enforces user trust anchors while preserving HTTP cleartext traffic for driver downloads and LAN printers.

patches_added.name: Clean Share Panel
patches_added.description: Removes clutter from the share panel and direct message dialog, including suggested quick emojis and the 'Send to new group' button.

patches_added.name: Comment Customizer
patches_added.description: Customizes TikTok's comment section, including native sort controls, clean text copying, disabling suggested emojis bar, enabling voice comments, and automatic comment translation.

patches_added.name: Disable Feed Long-Press Actions
patches_added.description: Disables long-press action gestures on feed buttons, including Like to repost, Share to quick DMs, and Comment to quick emojis.

patches_added.name: Disable Post-Download Share Dialog
patches_added.description: Suppresses the automatic 'Share to' and friend suggestions bottom sheet that pops up after finishing a download.

patches_added.name: Hide Inbox Promos & Alerts
patches_added.description: Hides promotional banners, streak mascot cards, contact sync suggestions, friend recommendations, and migration guide tooltips in the inbox and direct messages.

patches_added.name: Hide Inbox Story & Status Tray
patches_added.description: Hides the horizontal story, notes, and status tray (Skylight) displayed at the top of direct messages and the inbox.

patches_added.name: Navigation & Header Declutter
patches_added.description: Removes clutter from the feed navigation and top header bar, including the Nearby feed tab, Community (Explore) tab, top-left LIVE broadcast button, and in-video bottom search suggestion bar.

patches_removed.name: Auto-Translate Comments
patches_removed.description: Automatically translates comments into your preferred language using TikTok's native translation engine.

patches_removed.name: Comment Sort Controls
patches_removed.description: Unlocks TikTok's native comment sorting menu (Hot, Newest, Creator only, With media) across all posts.

patches_removed.name: Copy Comments Without Username
patches_removed.description: Copies only the comment text without prepending the author username.

patches_removed.name: Disable Comment Suggested Emojis
patches_removed.description: Removes the horizontal bar of suggested quick emojis displayed above the comment input box.

patches_removed.name: Enable Voice Comments
patches_removed.description: Forces the native voice comment recording button in comment input bars, bypassing regional rollout restrictions and remote server blocks.

patches_removed.name: Hide Community Tab
patches_removed.description: Removes the Community (Explore) tab from the top navigation feed strip.

patches_removed.name: Hide Feed Search Bar
patches_removed.description: Removes the search suggestion pill and trending bar ('Search · <keyword>') from the bottom of feed videos, providing a clean viewing area without search distractions.

patches_removed.name: Hide Nearby Feed Tab
patches_removed.description: Removes the Nearby (local city or region) feed tab from the top navigation feed strip.

patches_removed.name: Hide Top-Left LIVE Button
patches_removed.description: Removes the top-left LIVE broadcast button and tab entry point from the top navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Feed Bloat & Distraction Blocker
patches_modified.description: Removes non-video clutter and floating ad widgets from the For You, Following, and Friends feeds, including Touchpoint Rewards pendants, floating ad stickers, suggested friend cards, mini-games, CapCut/template creation prompts, memories ('On This Day'), surveys, mini-drama paywalls, and in-feed search recommendations/interest cards.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes non-video clutter and floating ad widgets from the For You, Following, and Friends feeds, including Touchpoint Rewards pendants, floating ad stickers, suggested friend cards, mini-games, CapCut/template creation prompts, memories ('On This Day'), surveys, and mini-drama paywalls.

patches_modified.name: Show Seekbar
patches_modified.description: Restores TikTok's native video seekbar and scrubbing controls where normally hidden or disabled.

patches_added.name: Keep a streak going
patches_added.description: Sends one message a day to a person you pick, at a time you pick, so a message streak with them keeps going on days you don't open TikTok. The message goes through TikTok's own notification reply. Adds the exact alarm and start at boot permissions the daily alarm needs. Off until you turn it on: Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_added.name: Look like the store app
patches_added.description: Answers TikTok's own checks of how it was signed and installed the way the Play Store app would. Its signature hash reads as TikTok's certificate and its installer reads as the Play Store. For a follow or a like that undoes itself on a refresh on a patched build. TikTok can also read the APK from native code, which no patch reaches, so it may not be enough on its own. Off by default. Switch: Hushfeed settings > Privacy.
